R1.description: Controller lifecycle workers launch with --permission-mode auto by default

R2.description: An explicit user-supplied --permission-mode is passed to the worker unchanged

R3.description: A phase transition alone does not verify a job whose action must produce a coherent plan review bundle; the bundle manifest must match the published plan_revision, on both execute and resume paths, using authoritative artifacts without importing Workflow scripts

R4.description: Controller does not launch a plan review against an incoherent plan bundle after such a failure, and the recovery it advertises is executable

R5.description: Regression coverage reproduces the observed partial /apply-plan-review case on execute, COMPLETED and LAUNCHED resume, next-step and recovery-guidance paths

R6.description: Full Controller and frozen Workflow conformance suites pass
